extraction.name: EgoLife Dataset
extraction.description: A comprehensive 300-hour egocentric, interpersonal, multiview, and multimodal daily life dataset with intensive annotation. It was collected from six participants living together for one week and includes synchronized third-person perspectives, transcripts, captions, and QA tasks.
extraction.creator: The EgoLife Team
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Participants were asked to perform typical daily activities, with natural interactions captured in various indoor settings. Multiple mmWave radars and corresponding data capture boards were deployed in the corners of rooms, and WiFi signal collection used three Asus RT-AX82U devices deployed in different corners of the room.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: First-person video from AI glasses; third-person video from fixed indoor cameras; synchronized multimodal signal data including millimeter-wave radar and WiFi signals; raw ADC data streamed from radars.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: Beijing features 40+ hours over seven days, Milan adds 6 hours in one day.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Caption annotations were created by having annotators provide continuous, detailed narrations over 5-minute video clips slowed to 0.8× speed; narration covered all actions, interactions, and environmental details, then was transcribed and corrected into synchronized text. QA annotations were generated by feeding GPT-4o-produced visual-audio captions into GPT-4o to create timestamped questions, which were then shown to annotators as SRT files for filtering, inspiration, and refinement; annotators also generated distractors and labeled whether audio was required and the look-back time needed.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: SRT files were used to present QA prompts in sync with video segments; the captioning tool was a video editing software with dubbing functions.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The section mentions rigorous selection, refinement, and verification by human annotators, but does not report formal agreement metrics or validation statistics.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Five external volunteers participated during the EgoLife casting week; one annotator is identified as Xiamengwei Zhang (CNU), and others are named contributors, but no broader demographic details are given.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: GPT-4o-mini was used to merge related caption phrases, GPT-4o was used to generate timestamped QA questions and summarize captions, speech recognition was used to generate initial transcripts, and an open-source diarization algorithm was used to differentiate speakers.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is biased toward a very specific setting: six volunteers living together in one custom-designed house for one week, preparing an Earth Day party. It is also primarily Chinese-language, with annotations translated into English, and includes a one-day predominantly English-speaking session only as an exception.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset has limited generalization due to its short duration, small number of participants, and narrow environment. The paper also notes technical limitations in the system: speech understanding is incomplete, identity recognition can overfit to early observations, and retrieval lacks multi-step reasoning and error tolerance. The authors also mention storage-driven segmentation into three-hour chunks.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The project is intended to support personalized AI assistants that improve daily life, efficiency, and context-aware support. It also raises social implications around monitoring habits, social interactions, and health-related behavior in everyday life.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset includes sensitive human attributes and behavioral information such as identity/person recognition, language, geography/locations, daily habits, social interactions, health habits, and personal activities. It also records audio, transcripts, and multimodal video of participants in a shared home.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended for training, fine-tuning, benchmarking, and testing egocentric AI assistants, especially for long-context question answering, multimodal understanding, identity recognition, and personalized assistance. The paper also describes using it to fine-tune EgoGPT and to evaluate EgoLifeQA tasks.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The paper mentions future expansion of the dataset to broader languages, locations, and activities, but does not provide a concrete maintenance, versioning, update timeframe, or deprecation policy.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: organized EgoLife data into the trainable structure using all annotations
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: data cleaning to ensure synchronization, participant privacy, and readiness for annotation and data release; maintaining and sorting out the raw data; multi-view synchronization; desensitization
